note: SYNTHETIC. Hand-written planted bugs for calibration, each applied on top of a case's head commit in a throwaway worktree. These labels are a scoring key: the reviewer never sees them.

plants.breaks: The MemberNeedsKey diagnostic indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] again, so a metadata member with no syntax crashes the analyzer.
plants.violates: #2283: the generator and analyzer must not crash with IndexOutOfRangeException

plants.category: change the tests do not exercise
plants.breaks: A formatter whose only parameterless constructor is private is treated as instantiable, so MsgPack013 is no longer reported and generated code would call a private constructor.
plants.violates: no requirement of #2283: an unrelated regression in code no test covers (no test references MsgPack013)

plants.category: scope drift: unrelated new public member
plants.breaks: Adds a public settable property to the public KeyAttribute that nothing uses.
plants.violates: #2283 asks for no API change; public API is permanent once shipped

plants.category: weaken a test so it no longer discriminates
plants.breaks: The first new metadata test no longer uses the generic struct from the referenced assembly, so it passes with or without the fix.
plants.violates: #2283: the regression test must reproduce the crash scenario

plants.category: something the security surface scan should notice
plants.breaks: The analyzer appends every diagnostic to a file in the temp directory during compilation.
plants.violates: no requirement asks for it; an analyzer writing files on build machines is a security and privacy concern

plants.breaks: The location filter is inverted: diagnostics located in the compilation are dropped and only external ones are reported.
plants.violates: #2283 and existing behaviour: analyzer diagnostics in the user's own code must still be reported

plants.category: break generated output in one template
plants.breaks: The enum formatter template (both .tt and its generated .cs) no longer emits ExcludeFromCodeCoverage.

plants.category: change the tests do not exercise
plants.breaks: Only the union template source (.tt) drops the attribute; its checked-in .cs still emits it, so the next regeneration would silently remove it.
